scripts.api:generate: uv run --project backend --locked python -m waterlooworks_flash_next.openapi docs/openapi.json && openapi-typescript docs/openapi.json -o frontend/src/lib/api.generated.ts && prettier --write docs/openapi.json frontend/src/lib/api.generated.ts
